works.body: Full body without background in 16:9, medieval rpg style character of farmer profession (emulating a Japanese ninja who uses the tools of the field to be an agile and fast assassin). References: flame stealer (honkai star rail). raven: revenant/ weapon taker (elsword). equinox night form (warframe). Recommended weapons: Egyptian kopesh-like sickle, machetes and knives, short axe. these can be with unique design, the character can have a lunar theme due to the lunar calendar for the plantations, I don't think it's necessary to revise the design with these specifications, I encourage.
